description: OpenArt Director lets you build a movies through conversation, from the first idea to a finished video up to 5 minutes long. Bring your own characters or let Director create them, with a continuous story and consistent characters and voices throughout. And if you want to change something, type it or say it or open the timeline and edit it yourself.  #openart #openartai #openartdirector #vibedirect #vibedirecting
